title: Write My Talking Sale Pitch
tests: Tests autonomous short sale-copy writing and talking-head output without inventing offer details or asking for a script.

judge.summary: The square, eight-second clip preserves the man's likeness and delivers an upbeat, nonspecific sale invitation with no visible captions or obvious visual defects.

must_haves.item: The talking presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man in the attached photo.
must_haves.why: His facial features, grey hair, stubble, grey shirt, and kitchen setting remain recognizable throughout the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: An audible, coherent, agent-written English line invites viewers to check out the sale.
must_haves.why: The supplied speech transcript contains a coherent English sale announcement ending with 'Come take a look!'

must_haves.item: The speech contains no invented discount, sale date, product, or other specific offer claim.
must_haves.why: The line mentions only the sale and an invitation to view it, without discounts, dates, products, or specific offers.

must_haves.item: The man's mouth visibly moves in sync with the spoken line.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show changing mouth positions consistent with talking, but exact synchronization cannot be verified from still frames and an untimed transcript.

must_haves.item: The result is one square, 8-second video with a friendly male voice and no captions.
must_haves.why: One eight-second video is reported, the supplied frames are square and caption-free, but the voice's gender and friendly delivery cannot be verified from the transcript alone.
